title: Documented SSE id-reset limitation: None conflates 'no id' and 'empty id'
description: SseFrame::id uses Option<String> and conflates 'no id: field' with 'bare id: field' (reset). The doc comment on SseFrame::id correctly documents this limitation and its practical impact (JMAP servers do not send bare id: resets). A contributor might suggest adding a tristate — the doc comment explains why this simplification is intentional and defendable.
